contains: You can see a coracle and a Wumpus here.
The Echo Chamber, close by, to the west.
The Wumpus, in the distance, to the east.
The Bottomless Pit, on the horizon, to the northwest.
The Bone Hollow, on the horizon, to the northeast.
The Landing, on the horizon, to the west.
The water heaves, the coracle tips, and the Wumpus has you. It does not hurry.
The coracle comes alongside the Wumpus.
